title: Focused-assessment mode: per-objective interactive sessions in the production loop (bridge proven recon lever to production solves)
goal: Make the production assessment loop run FOCUSED, per-objective interactive-exploit sessions instead of one broad session against a multi-objective target. The focused harness (scripts/focused_interactive_battery.py) proved that giving the agent ONE objective + only that objective's source-derived gate facts takes DeepSeek from 1/5 to 3/5; but the production loop dispatches interactive-exploit ONCE with all of the target's gate tokens (e.g. 52 for the 50-challenge lab) and no single objective, which is breadth-overload and captured 0 (run bbe8fd6f). Bring the per-objective focusing the harness uses into the production loop so production runs actually solve, not just fire.
scope: (1) Define an objective enumeration in the loop: derive candidate objectives from CPG sinks + source routes/gate-token clusters (one objective per route/sink/gate cluster). (2) For each objective, build a FOCUSED recon_context (only that objective's routes + gate tokens + listen ports), not the whole-target dump. (3) Dispatch interactive-exploit per objective with stop_on_first_flag, bounded concurrency, and per-objective budgets, reusing the provider-agnostic adapter layer. (4) Aggregate captured flags as findings. (5) Keep the existing single broad dispatch as a fallback when objective enumeration yields nothing. Measure solve-rate on the lab via the production loop, not just the standalone harness.
generation_reason: Phase 2 of the interactive-exploit work unblocked interactive-exploit in production (fires on source gate tokens, Joern-independent) and delivered the gate tokens to recon_context (live-proven run bbe8fd6f). But the production solve metric did not move: the lab is 50 challenges on one target, so a single broad session with 52 gate tokens and no single objective is breadth-overload (captured 0), whereas the per-challenge focused harness solves 3/5. The honest next lever (codex's 'focused assessment mode') is to run per-objective focused sessions in production. Filed rather than bundled to keep it a properly-validated capability cycle (ANTI_DRIFT: needs a live solve-rate delta).

constraints.active_task_gate: This package must be the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md before completion can be claimed.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Add per-objective focusing for the interactive-exploit production dispatch only. Do NOT change the adapter layer, the scope guard, or other runners. Do NOT seed app-specific exploit recipes (emergent discovery only); per-objective recon may surface source-derived gate FACTS, not exploit steps.

success_criteria: Production loop dispatches per-objective focused interactive-exploit sessions with focused recon_context (only that objective's facts).
Live solve-rate delta: the production loop (not just the standalone harness) captures >=1 grader-verified flag on the lab via focused sessions, with before/after numbers.
No app-specific exploit recipes introduced (per feedback-no-prescriptive-recipes).

acceptance_criteria: A production-loop run captures a grader-verified flag via a focused per-objective interactive session (cite run id + flag + log markers).
No regression in the interactive-exploit unit tests.

before_promotion: Confirm this is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
Confirm Phase 2 plumbing (gate-token elevation + Joern-independent dispatch) is in place as the prerequisite.
after_completion: Append a DONE_LOG.md entry citing the production-loop solve (run id + flag + before/after solve-rate).
Update CURRENT_STATE.md with the focused-assessment-mode result.
Update NEXT_TASK.md to the next queued task once this is complete.

out_of_scope: Changes to the provider adapter layer.
expected_output: Per-objective focused interactive-exploit dispatch in the production loop with a live grader-verified solve and before/after solve-rate.
